prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Angola
Primary request: Mbanza Kongo on its green Angolan plateau, featuring the weathered ruins of the old Kulumbimbi cathedral.
Subject: Modest roofless rectangular remains built from rough pale brown stone, low thick walls with a simple arched opening and irregular worn wall tops, grassy heritage grounds. Emphasize surviving ruins, not a reconstructed intact church.
Scene/backdrop: A green plateau with broad leafy trees, grass and a subtle small-town hint of low buildings beyond the heritage grounds, blue sky.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable ruin geometry, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Wide view with the complete low ruin enclosure centered, occupying about 60% width and safely within the central 75% of width and height, generous grass and sky around it for cropping.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, quiet and welcoming.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No giant intact European cathedral, towers, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected original PNG. Low roofless rough-stone cathedral ruins with worn walls and arched opening, grassy heritage grounds, leafy trees and small town on green plateau. No giant intact cathedral or towers. Painting matches reference; central ruin form is clear, outer enclosure extends slightly beyond central 75% width. No text/UI/flags/logos/unrelated landmark. Stylized educational view.
